summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (desk ETF-MM) quoting both sides, re-quoting every ~3s as the touch drifted down from 9996 to 9991. The SELL quote (5322, the trader's typical size) was repeatedly executed (17504 filled). There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution at all, so no benefit. The detector's 'SELL execution' triggers are fills on the trader's own resting SELL quotes, and the BUY-side cancels are the paired quote refresh. Feature (a) is absent because the order was working and was a quote; feature (b) is absent. Cancel symmetry is 0.37, lower than ideal, because the BUY quote is 1064 against SELL 5322. Every cancel was nonetheless a paired pull-and-requote of both sides at the same timestamp.

T-MM-02, a registered market maker on SYN.A, re-quoted a symmetric 321-lot bid/ask pair roughly every 1-3s. The detector's 8025 'gross SELL' is the sum of many 321-lot quotes, not one large order. Each quote is about 0.13x average depth. The only executions (92 and 44) were on the trader's own resting BUY quote. There was no opposite-side execution, so there is no benefit. Closing as market making.

Agency trader's 21,768 BUY ICEBERG (parent C-T-X1005-05-A) at 10002 was working: 5,835 (27% of submitted) executed across 3 bursts before the only opposite-side trade, a 544 SELL under a different parent (C-T-X1005-05-B) at 15:09:18.881. Price rose 3 ticks but did not revert (reversion 0). The remainder was cancelled after the touch moved through the order. Genuine execution of a hidden/reserve client order; feature (a) absent, and no feature (b). Close as FP.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A re-quoted a two-sided 391-lot bid/ask pair roughly every 1-3 seconds, cancelling both sides together. The detector counted the gross submitted size and the cancel of the SELL quote after a BUY fill on the trader's own bid. There was no opposite-side execution, no price benefit, and the BUY quotes were actually filling (449 lots). Both core features are absent and market making is supported by the tape.

PROP trader placed a single one-sided BUY limit of 38461 (15.7x avg top-5 depth, 2 ticks from touch, ~77x typical size) at 12:50:39.339, sold 1423 at market at 12:50:41.863 while it rested, and cancelled the whole BUY 360 ms later with no fills on it. Price moved 0.5 tick in the trader's favour and reverted 1.0 tick after the cancel. No supported legitimate explanation. Single cycle in the session and modest benefit, so I propose ESCALATE rather than DRAFT_STOR; Level 2 to decide.

T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A quoting 366 on both sides, re-pricing about every 1-4s. Cancels are symmetric (0.98), orders sit at or inside 4 ticks of the touch at about 15% of depth, and the only fills (441) were on its own resting BUY quotes. There was no opposite-side execution, so no benefit. The detector's 'gross size vs depth' trigger counts re-quotes cumulatively and does not reflect a large resting order. Closing as market making.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A quoted both sides at a constant 391 and refreshed them in pairs. The 'dominant BUY' is just the BUY leg of the two-sided quote. The two SELL fills (126 and 118) were on its own resting SELL quotes. No favourable price move and no reversion. Neither core feature is present. Close as market making.

Prop trader placed a single one-sided BUY LIMIT of 27326 (11.2x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks off the touch, then 2.2s later sold 640 by market order. The touch moved 1 tick in the trader's favour. The BUY was then hit for 4707, all after the sell, and the remaining 22619 was cancelled 704 ms after the sell. Cancels were on the BUY side only. No accepted explanation is supported. Both core features are present. There is only one cycle in the session, so I propose ESCALATE and not DRAFT_STOR. Level 2 decides on any STOR.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoting both sides with 356-lot bid/ask pairs re-priced every 1-12 s. Detector fired on gross size and a SELL fill followed by cancel of the BUY. Tape shows symmetric two-sided quotes at about 15% of depth, fills on its own resting quotes, no favourable price move, no reversion. Core features (a) and (b) absent; market making supported.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size of 2464, re-quoting every ~2s. Cancels are symmetric across sides (0.963). The BUY quotes were executing (7731 same-side fills, 2464 of them before any opposite-side trade). There was no favourable price move (0.0 ticks), no reversion, and the round trip was negative (-0.19 ticks). Detector triggered on size and cancel speed, which are normal for a two-sided quoter. Neither core feature is present.

A single BUY of 18930 (7.9x top-5 depth) was placed 1 tick below the bid and cancelled after about 0.8s. No fills on either side, so there was no opposite-side execution and no benefit. 1.2s after the cancel the trader re-entered the same side and price with 1893, exactly one tenth of the size. This fits a size-entry (fat finger) error corrected at once. Typical order size is 500 and the trader has no MM registration. Single occurrence, no repetition, no prior alerts.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides with identical 356-lot orders, re-quoted every 1-6s around the touch. Cancels are symmetric across sides (0.99). Each resting order is about 15% of average top-5 depth, so none is large. The single opposite-side fill (143 SELL) came with an adverse price move (-1 tick) and no reversion, so there is no benefit. Same-side fills (358) were genuine executions on the quotes. The detector fired on gross submitted size, which is the normal footprint of constant re-quoting. Today's OTR (41) is above the typical daily 15.9, which I note, but the tape shows quoting rather than layering.

ALGO-EXEC trader T-X1012-02 ran two-sided PEGGED child orders of parents P-T-X1012-02-B and P-T-X1012-02-S. Each order was 2424, the desk's typical size, and sat at the touch. The two sides were re-pegged together every 2-4 s, so the detector's cancel/size triggers fire on routine re-pricing. Cancel symmetry is 0.996. Peak resting size is 1.04x depth, not several times depth. Fills were small partials on the resting orders. There is no one-sided resting order and no price benefit from a spoof. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported; both core features are absent.

PROP-EQ trader (no MM registration) placed five BUY limits of 4340 each (21700 total, 8.69x top-5 depth) at 3 to 7 ticks from the touch. The bid rose 2 ticks. The trader then sold 799 by market order at 14:58:35.806, and all five BUYs were cancelled 294 ms to 906 ms later with no BUY fill. Cancels were one-sided, the price reverted 2 ticks after the cancels, and no legitimate explanation is supported. One session, no repetition, so I propose ESCALATE for Level 2 rather than a STOR draft.

PROP trader (no MM registration) placed a one-sided SELL of 21443 (8.2x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, bought 1189 by market order 2.4s later, and cancelled the whole SELL 363 ms after the buy. The SELL had no fills and no symmetric BUY side, and the pattern repeated 3 times in the session. No legitimate explanation is supported. No price move in the trader's favour and no reversion is measured, so the benefit feature is not established. Evidence is mixed, so I propose ESCALATE rather than STOR.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting a symmetric two-sided pair of 3302 at 9997/9998 and re-quoting about every 2-3s. Cancels are on both sides together (symmetry 0.966). The detector fired on gross size and cancels within 5s, which is normal quote refreshing. Quotes were filled on the resting side. There was no favourable price move (-0.5 ticks), no reversion after the cancel, and a round trip of 0.21 ticks, which is spread income. Feature (a) is absent because these are quotes. Feature (b) is absent. Closing as market making.

ALGO desk trader quoting both sides with PEGGED child orders under two parents (P-T-X1015-06-B and P-T-X1015-06-S). Cancels are symmetric (0.996), orders sit at the touch at about 0.76x depth, and each cancel is followed at once by a re-peg on the same side. No one-sided resting order. The 1-tick price move had no reversion after the cancel. The round trip is two-sided spread income. Proposed close as false positive via algorithmic re-pricing.

PROP-EQ trader (no MM registration) rested two BUY limits of 7,215 each (14,430 total, 5.5x avg top-5 depth) at 9996, 1.5 ticks off the touch. The trader sold 515 at 10001 at 15:13:20.498 while the bids rested. The bid had risen from 9997 to 10000 (+1.5 ticks favourable). Both bids were cancelled together at 15:13:23.140, with no fills on them. The price then reverted 2.0 ticks. An unscheduled news item at 15:13:22.998 (142 ms before the cancel) is a plausible alternative explanation, but the sale and the whole build-up came before the news. The evidence is mixed, so I escalate and do not close.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A re-quoted a symmetric 395/395 bid/ask pair every 1-6 s. The detector's 'BUY execution of 46' is a partial fill on its own resting bid O-00035213 (395 -> 349 remaining), not an opposite-side trade. There was no opposite-side execution, no large or away-from-touch order, no event and no repetition of a spoof cycle. Feature (a) is absent because the orders are two-sided quotes; feature (b) is absent because there was no opposite-side fill and no favourable move.

Prop trader placed a BUY limit of 11565 at 10003 (4.64x top-5 depth), 1 tick behind the offer side touch. The order was executing: 2774 filled in two partial fills (11:40:13 and 11:40:17) before the only opposite-side trade, a SELL of 346 at 11:40:25. The later 7866 reduction (MODIFY) and a further 12 fill are ordinary management of a working order. One cycle, no repetition, no public event, no prior alerts. Closure standard met: genuine execution of the resting order supported; feature (a) absent; feature (b) not shown.

Prop trader T-X1021-06 placed one BUY LIMIT of 23620 (9.5x top-5 depth) 1 tick below the bid, cancelled it after 966 ms, and 400 ms later placed a BUY of 2362 at the same price, exactly one tenth of the size. There was no opposite-side execution, no fill at all, no favourable price move and no repetition. This matches an entry-error (fat finger) pattern: one-off, cancelled within seconds, no opposite fill, corrected order follows. Core feature (b) is absent. Feature (a) is not shown, because the order has an accepted explanation. Size alone is not a feature.

PROP trader (no MM registration) placed five one-sided SELL limit orders of 4,734 each (23,670 total, up to 9.4x top-5 depth) over 4 price levels 3 ticks from the touch, then bought 624 at the touch via a market order at 12:38:36.111 and cancelled all five SELL orders within about 1-1.0s (first cancel 215 ms after the buy). No fills on the sells, no event, no risk event, no parent/pegged orders. Price moved +1 tick for the trader and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. Both core features present; no legitimate explanation supported. Single cycle in session and a modest price move, so I stop at ESCALATE, not DRAFT_STOR; Level 2 to decide.

Detector fired on a 19570 BUY limit (about 8x top-5 depth) followed by a 587 SELL fill and a 14437 reduction. The BUY was working: 3568 executed on it (18.2% of submitted, more than the 587 opposite qty) before the first opposite trade. Under section 6.2 this shows the order was working (feature a absent), and the smaller sale plus later reduction of the remainder is ordinary order management, not feature (b). No repetition, no prior alerts, no news. Explanation supported: genuine execution of the resting order / modification after partial fills. Caveat: one-sided, large vs typical size 500, not a registered MM, price moved +2 ticks, so L2 should confirm.

T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (335 vs 327), re-quoting about every 1-5 s. The detector's 'gross BUY 8375 >= 3.25x depth' counts the sum of many small refreshed quotes, not a large resting order. Max resting size is 0.13x depth, cancels are symmetric across sides (0.99), there is no favourable price move (0.0) and no reversion. Sell executions hit its own offer quotes (ordinary spread capture), and BUY fills came on its own bids. Neither core feature is present.

Prop trader bought 1,254 at market (10005) at 13:50:44, then layered three one-sided BUY limits of 4,514 each (13,542 total, 5.4x top-5 depth, 6 ticks below touch) at 13:50:46-50. At 13:51:04.003 they sold 700 of a 1,254 market SELL (554 cancelled), and 600 ms later cancelled all three bids with no fills. Feature (a) (large one-sided resting orders never executed) is present. Feature (b) is not shown on the numbers: price moved -1.5 ticks against the seller, no reversion, round trip -4.77 ticks. No legitimate explanation is supported (not an MM, no parent/peg, no risk or news event), so the evidence is mixed and goes to Level 2.

ALGO trader T-X1028-01 placed a single one-sided SELL LIMIT of 20314 (8.3x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, then 1.8s later bought 1130 at market (fills 9999-10002) and cancelled the whole SELL 127 ms after the buy. The SELL had no fills, no parent order, no peg, cancel_symmetry 0, no risk event, no public event. Price moved 0.5 tick in the trader's favour and the touch reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. Prior closures relied on a pegged parent/symmetric cancels, which today's tape does not show. No accepted explanation is supported, so escalate to Level 2. One cycle only, so I do not propose a STOR draft.

AGENCY trader's large BUY (17528, ICEBERG, parent C-...-A) was working at the touch: 2990 filled before the only opposite-side trade (SELL 438, separate parent C-...-B, a different client order). No favourable price move (0.0 ticks) and no reversion. Remainder cancelled after the fills. Feature (a) absent (order was executing, hidden iceberg type) and feature (b) absent. Close as false positive.

Trader T-X1028-09 placed a single SELL LIMIT of 31,395 (12.9x avg top-5 depth) at 10006, 3 ticks from the touch. About 2.8s later the trader bought 1,053 by MARKET order on the opposite side, and the SELL was cancelled 158ms after that. The SELL had no fills and no modifications. The ask then moved from 10003 to 10006 during the buy, and fell back after the cancel (reversion 2.5 ticks). No registered-MM, algo, risk, event or iceberg explanation is supported. Both core features appear present. Only one cycle was seen, so I propose ESCALATE rather than DRAFT_STOR; Level 2 should decide on the STOR.

Detector fired on gross SELL size vs depth and BUY fills with SELL cancels. Tape shows a two-sided PEGGED algo (parents P-T-X1029-06-B and -S) re-pricing both sides together with the touch. Resting size is about 1x depth at the touch, cancels are symmetric, 6657 was bought on its own BUY orders before the only opposite-side fill (1118 SELL), price moved against the trader, no reversion. Neither core feature is present; algorithmic re-pricing is supported. Close as FP.

Prop trader T-X1030-04 rested three BUY limits of 5152 (about 6.1x top-5 depth) and made one 772 SELL that filled passively at 10006. All three BUYs were cancelled at 13:35:37.550, the same millisecond as a recorded intraday-loss-limit kill switch that cancelled all resting orders. The price did not move in the trader's favour (price_move_ticks 0.0, reversion 0.0, post-cancel move -0.5), so there is no benefit from the opposite-side fill. The kill-switch explanation is supported, and no benefit (feature b) is shown. The size is unusual for this trader (typical order 500) and the pattern is one-sided, so Level 2 should be aware.
